keyDates.text: DHS Duration of Status rule takes effect -- F-1 and J-1 visa holders now admitted for fixed periods (up to 4 years) rather than open-ended D/S; post-graduation grace period for F-1 students cut from 60 to 30 days
DEADLINE: Public comment period closes on ED's proposed accreditation overhaul NPRM (published Aug. 20); final rule targeted for Nov. 1, 2026, effective July 1, 2027
End of federal Fiscal Year 2026; Congress passed a CR on Sept. 1 funding the government through Dec. 11 at current FY26 levels, including max Pell Grant of $7,395
Early Decision / Early Action deadline for most selective universities in the 2026-27 application cycle, including Brown ED, Harvard REA, and Penn ED
DEADLINE: Public comment period closes on Treasury/IRS proposed rule that would revoke 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status for private schools using race in admissions, scholarships, or other programs
ED targeting final accreditation overhaul rule by this date; would reshape how accreditors are recognized, eliminate regional/national distinctions, and mandate outcomes-based standards
Current continuing resolution expires; Congress must pass FY2027 appropriations or face government shutdown -- Education, NIH, NSF, and student aid funding all at stake
Regular Decision deadline for Harvard, Princeton, Columbia, Brown, Penn, and most other selective institutions for the Class of 2031

charts.title: Projected Endowment Tax Bills: Top Ivy League Schools, 2026-2030 (AEI Estimates)
charts.sourceText: National Review / American Enterprise Institute, July 2025
charts.footnote: AEI projections based on 8% excise tax on net endowment investment income, 2026-2030. Princeton has since expanded financial aid potentially reducing its tuition-paying students below the 3,000-student exemption threshold.

charts.title: Fall 2026 International Student Enrollment Outlook: Key Decline Indicators
charts.footnote: Data sourced from NAFSA Fall 2026 Outlook (Aug. 11), AAU Data Exchange, and Common App 2026-27 cycle data as cited by NAFSA. Figures represent percentage declines vs. prior year.
